title: Bike Engine Components Manufacturer in Nepal | Autologic
description: Autologic Industries supplies bike engine components for Nepal, precision-made to OEM tolerances and sent overland to dealers and workshops.
banner_desc: Precisely made engine parts for motorcycles that climb, carry and commute across Nepal.
hero_sub: Accurate Parts for Engines Working Hard at Altitude
hero: Motorcycle engines in Nepal deal with long climbs, cold starts on winter mornings and heavy loads on rough roads. Our bike engine components for Nepal are made to tight tolerances so engines keep running well between overhauls.
Components are produced on our CNC machining and die casting lines at an IATF 16949 certified plant, and they fit without the filing or shimming that poor parts often need.
We follow international standards for design, materials and production, and test parts for demanding road and weather conditions.

pillars: Precise engineering gives long life under steady load.

faq_intro: Questions from Nepali dealers and workshops about our engine parts.
faqs: How do I confirm parts will fit?
Send model names, part numbers or a sample and we will confirm fitment before you order.
What quality checks are carried out?
Checks run at each production stage in our IATF 16949 certified plant, and parts are tested for tough road and weather conditions.
Can you make parts from our drawings?
Yes. Our casting and CNC lines can produce them after a feasibility review, with samples for approval.
Can I mix bulk and custom items?
Yes. Both use the same ordering process with clear prices.
Overland from India in protective packing, with border documents prepared.
Can engine parts ship with clutch parts?
Yes. Many dealers combine them in one consignment.
Can components be packed for retail sale?
Yes. Dealers can receive engine parts in boxes printed with their own brand and part numbers.
